description: Wonewoc, WI – Juneau County organic farmer Tony Kurtz announced on Tuesday that he is running to represent the 50th Assembly district. Kurtz entered the race following fellow Republican Ed Brooks’s retirement from the seat.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Kurtz For Assembly
title: Organic Farmer, 20 Year Army Veteran Tony Kurtz Announces Run for Assembly - Kurtz For Assembly
